scope: Only the three byte-pinned optional component directories are omitted. Core loader, bootstrap, security/process/file modules, unchanged pywin32.pth, distribution metadata and all license files are retained. No Windows execution is claimed.
unsupported_optional_apis: Pythonwin interactive GUI, DDE, MFC UI and Scintilla components are not distributed.
win32comext.mapi Exchange/MAPI and win32comext.axdebug debugging APIs are not distributed.
Retained optional pywin32 helpers/demos may reference these unavailable APIs; this is a Core subset, not a complete pywin32 installation.
